reason: Lemma: for n>=2 every g in SL_n(R) is a product of at most 2n^2+6n elementary transvections; explicit real Gaussian elimination with pivot repair (at stage k at most 2(n-k)+1 transvections, at most n^2-1 in total), the six-transvection factorization diag(a,a^{-1}) = t_+(a) t_-(-a^{-1}) t_+(a) (t_-(1) t_+(-1) t_-(1)) in each 2x2 block (verified by direct multiplication), and inversion. Source: Breuillard Exercises Sec. 2 II.1 (real field only; no integer bounded-generation theorem). Deps all published.
